comment: Line coverage floor per package, read by scripts/coverage-gate.mjs. Every package not listed is held at `default`. An exception needs a reason. Floors marked 'behind' were set to the package's coverage when the gate was added, minus two points: raise them as tests land, never lower them without saying why here.

desktop.reason: Electron shell: the main process and preload only run inside Electron, so only the config side is unit tested

tauri.reason: Tauri shell: the Rust-side bridge and window code only run inside a Tauri webview

mobile.reason: Capacitor shell: the native bridge only runs on a device or simulator

platform.reason: Detects and bridges Electron, Tauri and Capacitor WebViews; the branches for the real runtimes cannot execute under Node

devtools.reason: Browser overlay: its panels are exercised in a real browser by tests/e2e/devtools.spec.ts, which does not count towards v8 coverage

kit-desktop.reason: behind: kit setup module, exercised by the CLI integration suite (kitr new --kit desktop), not by unit tests

kit-tauri.reason: behind: kit setup module, exercised by the CLI integration suite (kitr new --kit tauri), not by unit tests

kit-mobile.reason: behind: kit setup module, exercised by the CLI integration suite (kitr new --kit mobile), not by unit tests

kit-realtime.reason: behind: kit setup module, exercised by the CLI integration suite and the kit-realtime Playwright projects

kit-saas.reason: behind: kit setup module, exercised by the CLI integration suite and the saas Playwright project

kit-site.reason: behind: kit setup module, exercised by the CLI integration suite and the kit-site Playwright project

tailwind.reason: behind: a Vite plugin and build hooks, exercised by the example builds

vite.reason: behind: plugin hooks that only run inside a Vite build
